requiredFindings.title: Validate the stage-dependent law value, not only its key
requiredFindings.detail: load_from verifies that stageDependentTransitions has exactly the ANALYZING_OR_READY_COMPLETE key, but never reads or compares its value. Both published tables put the actual increment-and-resolve law in that value. Keeping the key and changing its value to arbitrary prose, a different increment rule, or even null still passes this check once the carrier-owned table pin is updated; Run::step continues to execute its hard-coded increment-and-resolve behavior. This contradicts the request and SCOPE claim that the stage-dependent next is pinned exactly and that an unimplemented prose law refuses Law. The existing unknown-law control mutates a state update, so it does not catch this omission. Current pinned-table traces are not shown to diverge; the defect is the required closed-loading guard.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Compare the complete stageDependentTransitions mapping, including the protocol-specific prose value, against the exact law implemented by the engine. Refuse unsupported values with TableRefusal::Law. Add loading controls for both protocols that change the value while preserving the key and update the carriers pin/length so content validation, rather than Pin refusal, is exercised.

requiredFindings.title: Require TS2 to declare the supported no-overlay descriptor
requiredFindings.detail: The TS2 branch checks only that an overlay key exists and guardAdditions does not. It never validates the overlay value, the TS2 base pin/rule count, or other transition members. Replacing the current none declaration with an unsupported overlay string or null is accepted. Adding stateAdditions or stateUpdateAdditions is also silently accepted and ignored, provided guardAdditions is absent. Thus the loader can report success while disregarding a declared TS2 transition overlay, contrary to the requested no-overlay check and closed-loading behavior. The Rust unknown-overlay-member test does not exercise this branch.
requiredFindings.requestedChange: Validate the TS2 base descriptor and require the exact supported no-overlay declaration (or an equally explicit closed representation of none), with a closed set of supported transition members. Reject a non-none declaration and unsupported executable overlay members instead of ignoring them. Add controls for altered overlay values, unexpected update/state members, and incorrect base metadata; preserve the current payload-selection/contextual-admission boundary.
